title: Laredo College and Rey Feo Laredo Foundation Award $50,000 in Scholarships to 25 Students
excerpt: Laredo College and the newly established Rey Feo Laredo Foundation joined forces Nov. 16 to create a scholarship program, presenting $50,000 in scholarships for 25 students across the fall and spring semesters, according to Laredo College.
content:
Laredo College and the newly established Rey Feo Laredo Foundation joined forces on Monday, Nov. 16, to establish a scholarship program for Laredo College students, according to Laredo College.

The foundation presented $50,000 in scholarships for 25 students across the Fall 2026 and Spring 2027 semesters, according to the college. The ceremonial check was marked for trade scholarships.

The foundation serves children and youth in Webb County under the theme “Education Sparks Interest,” according to Laredo College, and it expands the legacy of the Rey Feo Scholarship Foundation in San Antonio.

Laredo College President Dr. Minita Ramírez said the partnership opens more doors for students and eases the financial barriers that can stand between them and their education, according to the college.

Sources: Laredo College, Nov. 17, 2026.
